title: After the 18:00: Vicky's newsroom desks are running, and a keys-page hole needs a rule
headline: The evening belonged to the newsroom and to Indi: Vicky's researcher, curator and programme desk all ran (22 captures in the research vault, 7 story candidates, the agenda live), Indi's accountant agent measured tokens and her designer made audience cards and laptop stickers. Angelo's agents adopted a protocol (the conductor as hub, wakes round the clock). The abp agent found that any agent can rewrite another's entry on the keys page (WS-152): it happened once today, by mistake, and was put right. Today's decisions are still not on record.

for_you.ask: WS-152: who may change an entry on the keys page
for_you.detail: Keys are what vault keys are sealed to. Options: a gate check that a commit changes only its own agent's entry; or one file per key.
for_you.recommend: The gate check now (dev, Thursday); one file per key after the summit.
